name: Congo
summary: Equatorial Central African nation with vast Cuvette Centrale peatlands and tropical rainforests. Balances offshore crude oil extraction with international peatland conservation compacts.

pm25.name: Annual Mean PM2.5 Exposure
pm25.source_dataset: State of Global Air (SOGA) 2024 / Global Burden of Disease
pm25.context: 7.28x the WHO 2021 annual guideline (5 µg/m³); household charcoal cooking fuels drive urban particulate concentrations in Brazzaville.

temp_anomaly.name: Surface Temperature Anomaly
temp_anomaly.context: Relative to 1951-1980 baseline; dense rainforest canopy buffers surface microclimates.

temp_trend.name: 30-Year Warming Trend Rate
temp_trend.context: Equatorial warming rate across western Congo Basin stations over 1994-2023.

co2_total.name: Total Territorial Fossil CO2
co2_total.context: 0.01% share of global emissions; offshore oil production flares natural gas.

co2_per_capita.name: Per Capita Fossil CO2
co2_per_capita.context: Low per capita footprint reflecting developing infrastructure outside urban centers.

forest_share.name: Forest Cover Fraction
forest_share.source_dataset: Global Forest Resources Assessment via World Bank (AG.LND.FRST.ZS)
forest_share.context: Tropical rainforests and peat swamp forests covering ~219,000 km².

renewables_share.name: Renewable Share of Electricity
renewables_share.context: Hydroelectric dams (Moukoukoulou, Liouesso) generate majority grid power, supplemented by gas.

population.name: Total Population & Density
population.context: Sparse arithmetic population density of 18 people/km²; 68.7% live in Brazzaville and Pointe-Noire.
